text: Artificial intelligence is changing the workplace in many ways. Companies now use automation to handle repetitive tasks, which saves time and reduces mistakes. Productivity tools powered by AI help workers organise schedules, write emails, and analyse data more quickly. Instead of replacing people completely, AI often works alongside humans. For example, doctors use AI to help diagnose illnesses, while teachers use it to prepare lessons. However, some jobs are disappearing because machines can do them faster. At the same time, new jobs are appearing, such as AI trainers and data analysts. This means workers need to learn new skills to stay competitive in a rapidly changing job market.
